preconditions.description: Number of vertices is between 2 and 300,000.

preconditions.expression: len(w_odd_even) == n and all(1 <= w <= 10**12 for w in w_odd_even)
preconditions.description: There are n weights for edges between odd and even vertices, each between 1 and 10^12.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == n - 1 and all(isinstance(edge, tuple) and len(edge) == 4 for edge in edges)
preconditions.description: There are n-1 edges connecting pairs of odd and even vertices, each described by four integers.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and x != y and 1 <= w1 <= 10**12 and 1 <= w2 <= 10**12 for x, y, w1, w2 in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge description has valid indices and weights between 1 and 10^12.
Number of queries is between 1 and 600,000.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(query, tuple) and len(query) == 2 for query in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query is described by two integers.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= 2*n and 1 <= v <= 2*n and u != v for u, v in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query has valid vertex indices.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of queries.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(length, int) and length >= 0 for length in output)
postconditions.description: Each output line is a non-negative integer representing the shortest path length.
